question: I can't find any record or proof that I asked to cancel. Can you cancel it as of last month anyway?
reply:
I see that you are asking to cancel your subscription as of last month, but you cannot find any record or proof of a previous cancellation request.
According to our policy, a cancellation takes effect on the date the request was received, and retroactive corrections for missed applications of a request are only available for requests made within the last 30 days, provided there is customer confirmation. Because there is no record of a prior request, we cannot validate a past request date.
If you would like to dispute a past charge, you may ask for any charge posted in the last 60 days to be reviewed by the billing team by requesting a billing review. Please note that cancelling your subscription stops future billing, but past charges must be handled through this billing review process.
